goal:
Create a workflow that first writes a shared review brief, then fans out to two
independent terminal reviewers. Each reviewer must leave a separate immutable note
and a verifier. There is deliberately no synthetic join step: the run is complete
only after both terminal receipts have been accepted. State readiness and done
criteria for each step, and provide explicit execution bindings.

deliverables.description: A checked left terminal review note.
A checked right terminal review note.

functional_requirements.description: The left reviewer provides a distinct observation.
The right reviewer provides a distinct observation.

nfrs.description: Each terminal review retains its own immutable output and verifier result.
acceptance: the two accepted note receipts are distinct and each verifier passes

assumptions: The host will perform both prompt packets and submit their actual results.
